subject: Weekly MAP check-in: aligning attendee windows and action owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly MAP check-ins — proposed cadence + windows

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As we discussed on the call, we'd like to set up a short weekly MAP check-in to keep close on evaluation milestones and the close timeline. Proposed structure: 30 minutes, standing weekly, quick status (5m), blockers/asks (10m), evaluation readout (10m), action-item review (5m).

Proposed time windows (PT):
- Tue 09:00–10:00
- Wed 12:00–13:00
- Thu 08:30–09:30

Please let me know which of those work for your stakeholders (Sara / Alex / procurement inbox). If none work, send a couple of 1-hour windows next week and we'll align.

I've attached the latest MAP workbook (MAP_v3.xlsx) with owners and dates — I updated the evaluation plan tab based on your scoring rubric.

Pending items I want to make sure are on the weekly agenda:
- Final test harness access (owner: Karthik)
- SLO/latency acceptance criteria confirmation (owner: Marissa)
- Deployment timeline for pilot (owner: Olga)
- Procurement checklist and PO timing (point of contact: procurement@brightbank.com)

Thanks — happy to adjust cadence; want to keep this tight while you're running the evaluation.

Cheers,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (workbook, 1 sheet updated)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightbank.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@brightbank.com>, procurement@brightbank.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP check-ins — proposed cadence + windows

Hi Olga —

Thanks — appreciate the structure. Quick note on availability: the proposed Tue morning PT conflicts with our weekly leadership sync; Wed lunch looks promising for our London-based analytics lead (Alex is in EST but can hop on). Thu early morning PT is tight for our procurement team: they prefer 11:00–13:00 EST.

Suggested compromises:
- Alternate weeks: Wed 12:00 PT (works for Alex and our EU folks) and Thu 11:30 PT for procurement-focused checkpoints.
- Or keep weekly 30m slot Wed 12:00 PT and schedule a monthly procurement deep-dive for PO/contract items.

Also two clarifications after reviewing MAP_v3:
1) We need the evaluation harness to write outputs to a secure S3 bucket under our account — can Karthik confirm access steps?
2) Can you add a row for "acceptance criteria: security scan pass" so procurement can sign off?

I'll cc procurement so they can flag PO timing constraints.

Best,
Sara
Sara Liu
Director, Product Integrations — BrightBank
sara.liu@brightbank.com

Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP check-ins — proposed cadence + windows

Olga — quick note: procurement tends to only unblock during business hours for them (11:00–15:00 EST). I'd push for the alternating-week approach you proposed (Wed 12:00 PT / Thu 11:30 PT) and handle calendar invites to avoid back-and-forth. Also suggest a 15-min "procurement only" buffer on the Thu slot in case PO questions spill over.

Marissa can own the SLO acceptance conversation; I'll take meeting notes and action item tracking this quarter.

Camila
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

> Thanks — appreciate the structure. Quick note on availability...

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightbank.com>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@brightbank.com>, procurement@brightbank.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Confirmed: weekly MAP check-in cadence + calendar hold + owners

Sara / Alex / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per the thread, we will adopt an alternating cadence:
- Week A: Wed 12:00–12:30 PT (weekly evaluation readout + blockers)
- Week B: Thu 11:30–12:00 PT (procurement deep-dive + PO status) — we will append 15m buffer for procurement runover when needed

I've created calendar holds for the next 8 weeks and shared the MAP_readout.docx summary to the Drive link above. Zoom + calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics).

Current action items (owners):
- Karthik Iyer: confirm evaluation harness S3 write steps and share an access checklist by Fri 12/10.
- Marissa Cole: finalize SLO acceptance criteria and add security-scan pass row to MAP_v3 by Mon 12/13.
- Olga Petrov: coordinate pilot deployment timeline and send updated mutual action plan; owner of weekly cadence.
- Camila Reyes: meeting notes and action-item tracker; will ping the group if we fall behind cadence.
- Procurements (BrightBank): flag PO timing constraints and confirm earliest PO date by next Thu 12/16.

If any attendee needs a different timezone window permanently, speak up and we'll adjust — the alternating cadence helps keep the evaluation on a predictable rhythm while giving procurement their focused slot.

Thanks all — looking forward to the first readout next Wednesday.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_readout.docx, calendar-invite.ics
